name: titan-memory
description: Persistent, provenance-aware memory and passive trace capture for Claude Code.

agent_name.title: Titan agent name
agent_name.description: Memory namespace under ~/.titan/agents/. Keep this stable.

capture_mode.title: Capture mode
capture_mode.description: How much Claude session data Titan may save: full, messages, metadata, or off.

capture_tool_io.title: Capture tool input and output
capture_tool_io.description: Include bounded, redacted tool arguments and results in passive traces.

recall_mode.title: Recall mode
recall_mode.description: Recall behavior: automatic bounded injection, manual skill/tool use, or off.

excluded_projects.title: Excluded projects
excluded_projects.description: Absolute paths or glob patterns where capture and automatic recall stay off.

retention_days.title: Raw trace retention days
retention_days.description: Days to keep Claude adapter raw traces before cleanup. Use 0 to retain until manually removed.

recall_limit.title: Automatic recall limit
recall_limit.description: Maximum memories considered for one automatic prompt-time recall.

recall_timeout_ms.title: Automatic recall timeout
recall_timeout_ms.description: Fail-open deadline in milliseconds for startup and prompt-time recall.
